articles.title: Cursor vs Windsurf vs GitHub Copilot (2026): which AI code editor should vibe coders use?
articles.desc: Cursor vs Windsurf vs GitHub Copilot compared for vibe coders: verdict, pricing checked 16 Oct 2026, who each suits, and FAQs.
articles.verdict: Pick Cursor if you want the deepest agent features and don't mind its new Grok/X-bundled plans. Pick GitHub Copilot if you want the cheapest solid paid tier ($10/month Pro) inside the IDE you already use. Pick Windsurf if you want a capable agentic editor at $20/month and like trying an alternative.

who.Cursor: Builders who live in one editor all day and want agent mode, cloud agents and automations (Premium plan and up).
who.Windsurf: Builders who want an AI-native editor with a free tier and a straightforward $20/month Pro plan.
who.GitHub Copilot: Anyone already on GitHub or using JetBrains/VS Code/other IDEs who wants AI without switching editor.

faq: Is there a free version of each?
Yes. All three list a free plan on their official pricing pages (checked 16 Oct 2026), with limited usage.
Why is Cursor's pricing linked to X/Grok?

Cursor's pricing page (16 Oct 2026) shows plans sold via X Subscription Corp with Grok features included. The Plus plan ($8/month) is Grok-models-only; third-party models are billed at API list price.
Which is cheapest for paid use?
Of the entry paid plans we checked: Cursor Plus $8/month (Grok models only), Copilot Pro $10/month, Windsurf Pro $20/month.

articles.title: Lovable vs Bolt.new vs v0 vs Replit (2026): best AI app builder for vibe coders
articles.desc: Lovable, Bolt.new, v0 and Replit compared: quick verdict, verified pricing (16 Oct 2026), who each is best for, and FAQs.
articles.verdict: Lovable is the fastest route from a prompt to a full-stack app if you don't code. v0 produces the best-looking React/Next.js UI. Bolt.new is great for quick in-browser full-stack prototypes. Replit is the all-in-one choice when you want building and hosting in one place.

who.Lovable: Non-coders shipping a full-stack web app, especially with Supabase.
who.Bolt.new: Builders who want to prototype in the browser with nothing to install.
who.v0: Front-end builders on React/Next.js who will deploy on Vercel.
who.Replit: People who want an agent plus hosting in one product and don't mind usage-based costs.

faq: Which has the most generous free tier?
Hard to compare directly: Lovable gives 5 daily build credits (up to 30/month), v0 gives 7 messages/day, Replit has a Free Mode, Bolt has a free plan (limits not compared here).
How much is Lovable Pro?
Unverified: the paid price wasn't shown on the pricing page we fetched on 16 Oct 2026. Check lovable.dev/pricing.
Do I own the code?
Lovable's pricing FAQ says you own the code and apps you build. We haven't verified the equivalent terms for the others.

articles.title: Supabase vs Firebase for vibe-coded apps (2026)
articles.desc: Supabase vs Firebase for AI-built apps: verdict, free tiers and pricing checked 16 Oct 2026, who each is best for, and FAQs.
articles.verdict: For vibe-coded web apps, Supabase is the default: Postgres, auth and storage, with built-in support in tools like Lovable and Bolt, plus new agent-friendly code-first features. Firebase is a solid alternative if you're in the Google ecosystem; its Spark plan needs no payment method.

who.Supabase: Anyone building with Lovable/Bolt or wanting a SQL (Postgres) database their agent can manage from code.
who.Firebase: Builders already on Google Cloud or wanting to start with no card on file.

faq: Which is free?
Both: Supabase has a $0 Free plan (free projects pause when idle); Firebase's Spark plan is no-cost with no payment method needed.
What do paid plans cost?
Supabase Pro starts at $25/month. Firebase Blaze is pay-as-you-go; eligible users may get $300 free credit. Per-product Firebase rates weren't checked.
What's new for agents?
At Supabase Select (2 Oct 2026) Supabase announced code-first schema/config, Docker-free local Supabase (alpha) and MCP servers for your app.

articles.title: Vercel vs Netlify for AI app deployment (2026)
articles.desc: Vercel vs Netlify for deploying AI apps: verdict, pricing checked 16 Oct 2026, who each suits, and FAQs.
articles.verdict: Vercel is the smoothest choice for Next.js and AI apps (AI SDK 7, AI Gateway, previews); Pro is $20/month. Netlify is simpler and cheaper to start for static sites, with a $9/month Personal plan.

who.Vercel: Next.js and AI SDK builders who want previews and AI Gateway.
who.Netlify: Static sites and simple serverless apps on a tight budget.

faq: Do both have free plans?
Yes: Vercel Hobby ($0) and Netlify Free ($0).
What's Vercel Token Pass?
Announced 15 Oct 2026 in early access for Pro teams: $30/month for $80 of GLM 5.3 and Kimi K3 credit through AI Gateway.
Can bills spike?
Both have usage-based extras (Vercel usage credit, Netlify credits). Set spend limits.
